aboutMe: Experienced Software Developer skilled in TypeScript and Angular, with a strong focus on simplicity and maintainability. I believe that a product's effectiveness lies in simplicity. I use a pragmatic approach to reduce technical complexity, turning it into clean code and clear, accessible documentation. Thanks to my empathy and strong self-learning attitude, I act as a facilitator within my team, promoting collaboration that helps everyone move toward shared goals more quickly and with fewer obstacles. These qualities also support me outside of work, where I serve as secretary and treasurer for a cultural association, managing meeting minutes and financial reports.

highlights.title: Development
highlights.description: Responsible for building complete modules of the core product, defining data models and REST services while keeping architectural complexity under control.

highlights.title: Documentation
highlights.description: I actively update product documentation, outlining standards and conventions to ease onboarding. I also look for new tools to improve documentation, such as adopting TypeSpec to generate API docs more quickly than manually producing Swagger files, boosting developer experience.

highlights.title: Delivery Support
highlights.description: After noticing repeated error reports, I defined simplified use cases for delivery teams. This made investigation easier and improved routing of issues to the correct team.

highlights.title: Recruiting & Onboarding
highlights.description: I support technical screening and onboarding of new hires. I helped onboard more than 5 people, with 2 of them reaching full autonomy in about 6 months.
